# Philadelphia Magazine

> Philadelphia Magazine is the definitive guide to Philadelphia news, dining, events, lifestyle, and local services with searchable directories for doctors, dentists, real estate, weddings, and more.

Philadelphia Magazine provides comprehensive coverage of Philadelphia's culture, dining scene, real estate market, and community services. The site features Foobooz (the dining guide), Be Well Philly (health and wellness), and curated best-of lists, alongside daily podcasts and newsletters covering local news and lifestyle.

## Key Topics

- Philadelphia
- Foobooz
- Best of Philly
- Be Well Philly
- Philly Mag Today
- Restaurants
- Real Estate
- Events & Entertainment
- Health & Wellness
- Weddings
- Local News
- Lifestyle & Culture
- Directories
- Philadelphia-area neighborhoods
- Wine & Dine 2026

## News & Content Hubs

- [Philadelphia Magazine Homepage](https://www.phillymag.com): Main hub for Philadelphia news, restaurants, lifestyle, and city guides
- [Philly News, Politics, People & Opinion](https://www.phillymag.com/news): Philadelphia news, politics, and opinion coverage from the magazine
- [Philly Mag Today Podcast](https://www.phillymag.com/philly-mag-today): Daily podcast featuring Philadelphia people, places, and local stories
- [Newsletters](https://www.phillymag.com/newsletters): Newsletter signup hub for Philly Mag Today, weddings, events, and content

## Dining & Restaurants

- [Foobooz | Philly's Best Restaurants and Bars](https://www.phillymag.com/foobooz): Foobooz dining guide covering Philadelphia restaurants and bar culture
- [The 50 Best Restaurants in Philadelphia: 2026](https://www.phillymag.com/foobooz/50-best-restaurants): Annual list of Philadelphia's 50 best restaurants and dining destinations
- [Philadelphia Restaurant Jobs](https://www.phillymag.com/foobooz/philadelphia-restaurant-jobs): Restaurant job listings for Philadelphia hospitality and food industry

## Events, Lifestyle & Culture

- [Things to Do and Events in Philly](https://www.phillymag.com/things-to-do): Philadelphia events guide with shows, concerts, and local activities
- [Life and Style, Shopping, Culture & More](https://www.phillymag.com/life-style): Philadelphia lifestyle, shopping, culture, and trend coverage

## Health & Wellness

- [Be Well Philly | Health, Wellness & Fitness](https://www.phillymag.com/be-well-philly): Be Well Philly health, wellness, fitness, and medical directory hub
- [Philadelphia's Best Doctors](https://www.phillymag.com/find-a-doctor): Philadelphia physician directory searchable by specialty and location
- [Philadelphia's Best Dentists](https://www.phillymag.com/dentists): Philadelphia dentist directory with specialty search for dental services

## Real Estate & Property

- [Homes, Real Estate and Development | Property](https://www.phillymag.com/property): Philadelphia real estate, homes, development news, and property guides
- [Residential Real Estate Agents in Philly](https://www.phillymag.com/real-estate-agents): Philadelphia real estate agents directory by neighborhood and location
- [Home Improvement & Design Listings](https://www.phillymag.com/home-design): Home design and improvement services directory for Philadelphia area

## Life Events & Services

- [Find Philadelphia Wedding Vendors](https://www.phillymag.com/weddings): Philadelphia wedding vendors directory with planners, venues, and photographers
- [Philadelphia Senior Living Communities](https://www.phillymag.com/senior-living): Senior living communities directory with assisted, independent, and memory care
- [Find a Private School in Philly](https://www.phillymag.com/private-schools): Philadelphia private schools directory searchable by grade and type
